apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: sh.helm.release.v1.other-tool.v1
  namespace: kubeflow-system
  uid: other-release-uid
  labels:
    owner: helm
    name: other-tool
    status: deployed
type: helm.sh/release.v1
data:
  release: e30=

# The upstream kustomize install, `kubectl apply -f
# https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/jobset/releases/download/v0.12.0/manifests.yaml`.
# Identities and labels are taken from that published build: ClusterRole
# `jobset-manager-role` (the only ClusterRole there carrying jobset.x-k8s.io
# rules), Deployment `jobset-controller-manager`, the two hardcoded webhook
# configuration names, and two webhooks per configuration — one for JobSets,
# one for their Pods — both against a single `jobset-webhook-service`.
#
# `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize` is what keeps this channel
# distinguishable from `helm template | kubectl apply`, which stamps
# `managed-by: Helm` without any release record and stays ambiguous.
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: jobset-manager-role
  uid: manager-role-uid
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [nodes]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: [jobset.x-k8s.io]
    resources: [jobsets]
    verbs: [create, delete, get, list, patch, update, watch]
  - apiGroups: [jobset.x-k8s.io]
    resources: [jobsets/finalizers]
    verbs: [get, patch, update]
  - apiGroups: [jobset.x-k8s.io]
    resources: [jobsets/status]
    verbs: [get, patch, update]
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration
metadata:
  name: jobset-mutating-webhook-configuration
  uid: mutating-uid
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
webhooks:
  - name: mjobset.kb.io
    admissionReviewVersions: [v1]
    failurePolicy: Fail
    sideEffects: None
    clientConfig:
      service:
        name: jobset-webhook-service
        namespace: jobset-system
        path: /mutate-jobset-x-k8s-io-v1alpha2-jobset
    rules:
      - apiGroups: [jobset.x-k8s.io]
        apiVersions: [v1alpha2]
        operations: [CREATE]
        resources: [jobsets]
  - name: mpod.kb.io
    admissionReviewVersions: [v1]
    failurePolicy: Fail
    sideEffects: None
    clientConfig:
      service:
        name: jobset-webhook-service
        namespace: jobset-system
        path: /mutate--v1-pod
    objectSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: jobset.sigs.k8s.io/jobset-name
          operator: Exists
    rules:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        apiVersions: [v1]
        operations: [CREATE]
        resources: [pods]
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingWebhookConfiguration
metadata:
  name: jobset-validating-webhook-configuration
  uid: validating-uid
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
webhooks:
  - name: vjobset.kb.io
    admissionReviewVersions: [v1]
    failurePolicy: Fail
    sideEffects: None
    clientConfig:
      service:
        name: jobset-webhook-service
        namespace: jobset-system
        path: /validate-jobset-x-k8s-io-v1alpha2-jobset
    rules:
      - apiGroups: [jobset.x-k8s.io]
        apiVersions: [v1alpha2]
        operations: [CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE]
        resources: [jobsets]
  - name: vpod.kb.io
    admissionReviewVersions: [v1]
    failurePolicy: Fail
    sideEffects: None
    clientConfig:
      service:
        name: jobset-webhook-service
        namespace: jobset-system
        path: /validate--v1-pod
    objectSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: jobset.sigs.k8s.io/jobset-name
          operator: Exists
    rules:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        apiVersions: [v1]
        operations: [CREATE]
        resources: [pods]
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: jobset-webhook-service
  namespace: jobset-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: webhook
    app.kubernetes.io/created-by: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: jobset
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 443
      protocol: TCP
      targetPort: 9443
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
    control-plane: controller-manager
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: jobset-controller-manager
  namespace: jobset-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: manager
    app.kubernetes.io/created-by: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: jobset
    control-plane: controller-manager
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
      app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
      control-plane: controller-manager
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: jobset
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize
        app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
        control-plane: controller-manager
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: manager
          image: example.invalid/jobset:test

# Synthetic. This is a compatibility fixture, not a published install
# channel: it pins the second identity set the non-Helm pattern accepts, the
# chart's `jobset-controller` name for both the ClusterRole and the controller
# Deployment, with no ownership metadata from any installer. The real non-Helm
# channel is the upstream kustomize build, covered by
# supported-nonhelm-controller.
#
# It is explicitly NOT `helm template | kubectl apply`, and must not be read
# as evidence that channel works. That channel renders
# `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm` from `jobset.labels` with no
# `meta.helm.sh/*` annotations, which the detector refuses as partial
# ownership evidence. No label here claims any installer.
# TestSupportedNonHelmEvidenceConflictsWithBundledOrPartialHelmMetadata pins
# that refusal.
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: jobset-controller
  uid: manager-role-uid
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jobset
rules:

    resources: [nodes]

  - apiGroups: [jobset.x-k8s.io]
    resources: [jobsets/status]
    verbs: [get, patch, update]

[deps] Operator-managed recovery guidance (issue #180):

  3. Inventory kubeflow-system and delete it only after applying the same protected-resource and quiescence checks.
